dogecoin.text: The delays apply to two separate requests submitted in March. Cboe BZX Exchange filed to list Franklin Templeton’s spot XRP ETF, while NYSE Arca proposed listing Bitwise’s Dogecoin ETF. Both applications are now part of a broader evaluation process under standard SEC timelines.
